The ever-growing complexity of the processor design is also growing the complexity of verification too. So, there is a need of automated tool that has the capability to hit the corner cases of the design and helps to ease the work of design verification. In this study we introduce an inhouse developed stress test tool which helps to provide stimulus for complex multiprocessor design for memory subsystem which is customized for ARMv8 core processor design. This tool demonstrates highly effective leveraging of ARMv8 PMUv3 to calibrate/grade stress tests in real time and by making use of its features to quickly come up with complex directed test cases for stress testing or bug hunting. It makes use multiple algorithms, PMU events and the test cases to verify the design. It has been observed that the tool developed has the capability to hit the performance bottleneck to verify the design by running random tests on design under test.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of FreeRTOS Based Video Capture System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The proposed work manifests the significance of a specialized middleware, like RTOS, for the management of application functions and system resources in a highly demanding real-time application. A video capturing and rendering system is used in the paper, to investigate on the design challenges and the role of RTOS in meeting the time constraints in a real-time system. The system either renders the captured video feed on the LCD terminal or transmits the encoded video feed by establishing a UDP connection with the remote host based on the software configuration. All the application functions are developed as FreeRTOS tasks with ATSAMV71 as the platform and hardware modules like OV7740 image sensor and an LCD display aiding the system with their respective functionalities. The performance is estimated from the system profile obtained from the trace visualization tool, SystemView. The study also gives an in-depth understanding on the tasks present, computational requirement and time constraints present in the system. Further performance enhancement can be achieved by using the advanced features such as Cache and Tightly coupled Memory (TCM) available on ATSAMV71 controller.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Voltage Droop Control Technique for DC Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This paper presents a simulation study of a dc microgrid with a voltage droop controller to regulate the grid output voltage and the power sharing between the sources. A dc microgrid having three microsources and a resistive load was modeled in Matlab/Simulink. Different aspects of voltage droop and Master-Slave controller are discussed. Design of voltage droop control technique by using proportional-integral controller is explained and modification was done by using Sliding Mode control which gave faster response and better voltage regulation.

articleTitle: Mitigation of Power Quality Issues in Distribution Grid Integrated To Photovoltaic-ECS
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: As the renewable energy is easily available in our surrounding, thus power generation from renewable energy sources becomes a prime strategy and it is also cost effective. Photovoltaic-ECS is utilize for active power transfer to load and grid during day time. Three leg voltage source inverter is also use which act as a shunt active filter during night. The power quality issues are the major concern in RES integrated to distribution grid. Various control strategies are given such as stationary reference frame PLL, rotating reference frame PLL, Decouple double synchronous reference frame PLL etc. for enhancement of power quality on grid side. This paper propose a D-αβ PLL scheme which is the combination of Decouple double synchronous reference frame PLL and αβ-PLL. This control includes all advantages of both PLL. Thus, it can be a solution for integrated RES having fault ride through (FRT) capability and maintain system balance in case of asymmetry condition on utility side and reduces the harmonic distortion. It help in synchronization of inverter and grid. The network is simulated in MATLAB environment to prove its fruitfulness.

articleTitle: Image Enhancement Techniques for Gastric Diseases Detection using Ultrasound Images
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The abdominal, gallbladder, pancreatic and stomach diseases are the largest and usually occurring gastric diseases among various age groups. To test the stomach related disease in a wide range, ultrasound testing is frequently used. In an ultrasound testing, high-frequency sound waves are transmitted in body tissues, to transfer the image information to a computer to display the output. The ultrasound testing is an easy, comfortable and safe procedure with no side effects. In ultrasound imaging system, soft tissue structures, such as liver, pancreas, kidney gallbladder organs and body parts are diagnosed. However, the ultrasound images carry noise and got corrupted. This paper presents application of three filtering techniques namely middle, unsharp and wiener filtering for removal of unwanted noise from corrupted ultrasound images. The comparative analysis is carried out by measurement of entropy of final set of images. The Matlab results indicates the best entropy and hence visibility qualities are obtained with unsharp filtering.

articleTitle: Design of Generic Verification Procedure for IIC Protocol in UVM
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: With the growth of technology, designs became more complex and may contain bugs. This makes verification an indispensable part in product development. UVM describe a standard method for verification of designs which is reusable and portable. This paper verifies IIC bus protocol using Universal Verification Methodology. IIC controller is designed in Verilog using Vivado. It have APB interface and its function and code coverage is carried out in Mentor graphic Questasim 10.4e. This work achieved 83.87% code coverage and 91.11% functional coverage.

articleTitle: Reactive Power Control and Harmonic Mitigation by using DSTATCOM with Different Controllers
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This paper explains about DSTATCOM related reactive power compensation using SOSMC(second order sliding mode controller) control technique to enhance the power quality. Reactive power compensation is required in distribution systems because in order to overcome problems related to sudden change in non linear loads. DSTATCOM plays extensive role in power systems, it is a shunt connected device placed at pcc with this device have more advantages like compensation of reactive power, reduce the harmonics at point of common coupling and grid side. In this Paper having detailed explanation about controller and for different sudden changing loads the performance of system is calculated based on reactive power compensation These values of compensated reactive powers are compared with other controller like proportional integral controller The analysis is proved using MATLAB/Simulink and simpower systems toolbox.

articleTitle: Plant Recognition using Watershed and Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Plant identification by recognizing its leaves has proven to be difficult as many leaves look identical. Hence, the aim of this work is to classify plants based on their leaf structure. The images acquired must undergo necessary image pre-processing like resizing, image enhancement, shadow removal and background removal. When the leaf is surrounded by multiple leaves, the image is segmented by watershed algorithm to separate each leaf. Eight different species of plants can be identified with the help of neural network which is capable of classifying a plant accurately. The final output consists of customized brief yet informative information about the plant.

articleTitle: RF Planning and Optimization Practices Applied to Improve the KPI’s of 4G LTE Network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The fast evolution of mobile communication and technology has contrived remarkable progress not only to comfort the everyday activity of people but also to accomplish a significant contribution to the tenacious computing environments. Also, the expectations of users have expanded from traditional mobile-voice-traffic to easy text communication including live streaming assistances and internet-access. This paper is based on advanced cellular technology, Long-Term-Evolution (LTE). It gives an exceptional conception of Radio Frequency planning of LTE network to improve the network performance by enhancing the Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

articleTitle: Cascaded Artificial Neural Network Based MPPT Algorithm for PV Application
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)

authors.preferredName: D. V. SIVA KRISHNA RAO K

abstract: The paper proposes an artificial neural network (ANN) for tracking the maximum power point. The nonlinear behaviors of photovoltaic (PV) array are a direct result of their dependence on temperature and radiation levels; hence the need to track maximum power point. Acceptable performance can be achieved using traditional MPPT techniques such as Incremental Conductance and Perturb and Observe, but the trade-off being accuracy and response time. Moreover, under rapidly changing environmental conditions deliver moderate performance.

articleTitle: Modified Cuckoo Search algorithm based Optimal Thresholding for Color Lip Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: For interpretation and analysis of the desired image, segmentation is recognized as a significant operation. Presently, facial surgical planning is one of the significant segmentation applications. In order to segment the images, the general method is thresholding as it includes noise robustness, which is more natural and precise. By employing the optimal thresholding depending on cuckoo search algorithm for lip image segmentation, effective results can be attained. To further increase the results of CS algorithm, in this paper, we include Levi distribution with CS algorithm for lip image segmentation and derived a new CS-L algorithm. The presented CS-L algorithm is tested on a set of lip images and results are validated under several aspects. The obtained simulation outcome has verified the superiority of the presented method.

articleTitle: Cross-correlation based distance estimation of single line to ground faults using Elman back-propagation neural network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In this article a novel method for the estimation of distance of fault location for single line to ground faults using cross- correlation and Elman Back Propagation Neural Network has been presented. In this proposed work a distinctive analogy has been incorporated between the cross-correlogram obtained from a non- faulty phase and a faulty phase in electric power system and an Electrocardiogram (ECG) of human heart at normal condition. Importance is also involved to the feature extraction & ECG-fault signals analogy, otherwise the majority of the scheme may not be implemented accurately. Furthermore this proposed method alleviates the problems related with fault distances by estimating it & reduces the faulty impacts on transmission line.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Application for healthcare Recommendation using Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The concurrence of a flood of health awareness campaigns, technological advances, the increasing need for accurate information and a stark increase in stress levels across people from all walks of life has served as an impetus for the emergence of numerous health oriented diet applications which serve as a convenient, cost effective and time saving route for the adoption of a healthier lifestyle. Most of the prevalent online diet applications either use well established scientific formulae to generate a discrete output or they are directly affiliated with a professional dietician or nutritionist to help chart out a diet plan for the user, in which case the application is rarely free. The former method, while accurate, does not present much scope for customization whereas the latter method, though personalized, is not a cost-effective option. In both the above alternatives, the application is not intelligent as the generation of successive outputs is completely dependent on the user inputs. This paper proposes a novel fuzzy set approach to generate an intelligent personalised diet plan for the user in accordance with several parameters that would be input by the user. Type-1 Fuzzy Sets and the MinMax method are used for fuzzification purposes. The application generates the optimal calorie range intake based on the user's profile using Fuzzy Sets.

articleTitle: Prototype Development Of Insulator Hardware With Corona Ring Installed For 400KV Transmission Network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This paper represents, Prototype development of 400KV Single Suspension Normal type Insulator Hardware suitable for ACSR Moose conductor. It contains overall Development of product including Designing, Manufacturing and Testing of Hardware, referring Indian Standard 2486 (all parts). Need of High voltage should be compared with the low voltage level in order to extracts the benefits. Aim of this study is to investigate and establish a procedure to determine and improve Mechanical and Electrical stability, Strengthens the Mechanical support for Insulator fitting and Conductor of transmission network. Therefore designing a prototype model of insulator hardware fitting suitable for ACSR moose conductor on existing standard is presented.

articleTitle: Image Compression Using Polynomial Fitting
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: A new efficient method to compress images using polynomial curve fitting approximation techniques is presented in this paper. The polynomial curve fitting represents many pixels by a smaller number of polynomial coefficients. The presented method is based on two distinct scanning techniques of the image under compression. In the first technique, we scan the image row by row, and in this case, we use first or second order polynomial to represent the chosen number of pixels from the row. In the second case, we scan the image using a block of pixels with variable dimensions and represent each block by a first order two-dimensional polynomial. Experimentally the method gives an acceptable compression ratio with reasonable reconstructed image quality.

articleTitle: Mechanization of G, C and D Chord playing system using servomotors for Acoustic Guitar
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Playing an acoustic guitar requires a skilled approach and involves hours of practice. Chord playing on the guitar requires proper placement and movement of human fingers along with the time synchronized plucking and strumming action of the strings. However, the involvement of human-based guitar control does not guarantee precise music generation repeatedly. The designed system offers reliable control to play G, C and D chord precisely. The system comprises of an Arduino based control unit and a servo-motor based actuation system that enables accurate pressing of strings on the fretboard along with time coordinated plucking or strumming operations at neck area and hole area of the acoustic guitar. The scheduler System is responsible for the generation of particular musical tune. The chords played were validated with existing audio processing tools.

articleTitle: Effect of Temperature on GaAs Junctionless FinFET Using High-κ Dielectric
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In this paper, the effect of temperature on GaAs Junctionless (JL) FinFET using high-κ dielectric has been studied at 200K, 300K, and 400K. JL FinFET, a sub-20nm device is designed using GaAs as Fin material. High-κ material is used as a BOX and as a spacer. Drain current is compared with the conventional JL device. Switching ratio is enhanced by 2.58×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> times, and I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">on</sub> is also increased by 70% in the proposed device as compared to JL FinFET at low temperature (200K). I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">on</sub> is found to decrease for GaAs JL FinFET with increasing temperature (200K to 400K), which is opposite to that of the conventional device. Even with the decrease of on current with temperature, I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">on</sub> shows 18% increase as compared to JL FinFET.Further, the effect of temperature on the band gap, electron mobility, and charge density is studied along the channel length. It is found that mobility plays an important role in the Galium Arsenide JL device when the device is on, and charge density plays an important role when the device is off. Higher switching ratio can be used in SRAM, and as the high-κ material is used, the device can be a good alternative for RF and microwave application in the sub-20nm regime.

articleTitle: Software Engineering based Cost Reduction Techniques for Different Testing Models
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Software engineering holds a major area for software testing which helps in the minimization of software costs, reduction of errors and overall maintenance. Software testing can be simplified to encompass it as validation and verification. Testing is a methodology of finding out errors in any specific developed program which do not cause any further bugs or interrupt and results in the smooth running of product. Various research papers are available already but still testing is one of the most practiced methodology for assessing the quality of the product. Testing is carried in different wheel of cycle. Software testing more adequately provides rapid development, reduced complexity in digital systems, which includes behavioral models.This paper discusses different software strategies such as unit testing, validation testing and techniques like white box technique, grey box testing and black box testing for object-oriented results. This paper also aims to discuss various existing testing techniques as well as improved techniques and also display the views of software testing community in general.

articleTitle: Advancement Of Home Appliances For Home Automation Using Human Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In this fast-moving world, people don't find time to save the basic necessities of life like water, fuel, power, etc. One of the greatest boons to the human being is the invention of electricity. The generation of electricity is a tedious process and today there are different sources for the production of electricity. But conservation of electricity or power or energy is not made properly. Around the world, many kinds of research works are in the progress to increase the conservation of energy based on the automated and proper control of the electrical appliances. Most of the energy wastage is due to the presence and absence of human beings in a room. When the conservation or the control is automated, then the wastage can be reduced drastically. Techniques to detect the presence of human being inside a room, increase and decrease in the intensity of the light in a room, detection and comparison of human activity based appliance control, automatic control of appliances through smartphones, techniques that involve IoT for controlling the devices, etc. These techniques may lead to an environment where energy saving can be automated without the involvement of human beings.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis for Active Power Loss Incorporating Distributed Generation in Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: A statistical investigation of real power loss in radial distribution system (RDS) incorporating distributed generation (DG) is presented. Statistical parameters for real power loss is obtained by Monte Carlo simulation (MCS). Samples for power loss is obtained by load flow technique. IEEE- 33 bus RDS is considered for the purpose. Load demands at buses have been treated as continuous random variable (CRV) assumed as Gaussian distributed. Moreover optimal buses for DG placement are selected by incremental power loss sensitivity criteria at selected locations. DG capacities have been integrated and considered as a Gaussian distributed. This paper not only gives statistical parameters but also evaluates probability distribution function and cumulative distribution function for RDS.

articleTitle: Land Cover Change Detection Using Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The experimental results prove that only few landscapes are remaining on the earth due to anthropogenic activities and the human activities, which has a great impact on the globe. As the population is getting increased day by day, there are many changes occurring in the land use and land cover which results in mitigating the agriculture land that leads to drought and other natural calamities. To reduce such impact on the globe, change detection techniques are very helpful for finding the areas where the change is occurring. Deep learning methods are being used efficiently in remote sensing projects these days. In this paper, Land cover classification and change detection is made using high resolution satellite images of Guntur region taken over the years 2013 and 2016 with Landsat-7. The change detection process is performed by using VGG 19 technique in Convolution neural network algorithm.

articleTitle: Emergence of Neuromorphic Chips to simulate Human Brain
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The recently evolved research on neuromorphic computing which is considered as the hardware acceleration of brain-inspired computing, which has been one of the best adaptable intelligences and is being widely used in various areas of applications ranging from basic neuroscience research, to pattern recognition and artificial intelligence. Although, computing power is technologically progressing in astonishing rate, the need to push computing power further always has been the dire necessity in the modern world. The paradigm shift from traditional convectional computing to neuromorphic computing can be the next generation of computing offering high computational speeds and greater efficiency when compared to the traditional way of information processing and computing. This invited paper, starts off with the background introduction of Moore's law followed by neuromorphic computing and end with recent innovations in the field and conclude with technological challenges and applications of neuromorphic computing in day to day life.

articleTitle: Stability control of High Speed Train using Robust PID Controller
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This paper presents control applications to high speed train. Aim of this study is to improve the ride quality and to minimize the semi-active suspension vibrations within tolerable limits by means of applying control technique. The system model considered here is of 17 DOF. This multi input and multi output model has so many difficulties to tackle on. Earlier so many control techniques including Linear Quadratic Regulator have been used to improve the system quality. Here robust PID controller is used to control vibration for high speed train. Simulation studies has been carried out using Matlab/Simulink.

articleTitle: Real Time Application and CPU Utilisation Monitoring Tool
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Real time monitoring of systems to prevent inappropriate activities, that are irrelevant to the course, especially during laboratory sessions is essential. Moreover, minimising the idle time of the systems that results in excessive power loss, contributes towards green computing. Overall enhancement of the implementation of a given task that is being performed by the students is equally important. This paper presents a solution which is a software application that not only monitors the activity of the students constantly but also terminates unnecessary applications dynamically. This real time application also keeps track of CPU utilisation to put idle systems to sleep, in turn mitigating unnecessary power consumption. It is built on a client-server architecture with the help of socket programming. Screenshots and logs of the clients' system are sent to the teachers on demand. This software hence aids in more efficient teacher-student interaction, better implementation of the task, increasing lab productivity and contributing towards green computing.

articleTitle: Comparative study of on-drive-current improvement techniques in charge plasma TFET
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This study utilizes the charge plasma (CP) technique instead of doping on Tunnel Field Effect Transistor (TFET) because the charge plasma technique provides an ease in fabrication process of devices. A CP-TFET with the combination of high k-dielectric (HD) oxide, dual material gate electrode (DMGE) and hetero-material is presented for enhancement of performance. The SiGe is used as source material in place of silicon to lower the tunneling distance at source-channel transition. Thus the ON-state device performance increases as tunneling rate enhances. Further, its comparison with traditional Single Metal CP-TFET, DMGE-CP-TFET and HD-DMGE-CP-TFET is reported in terms of off-current (I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OFF</sub>), on-drive-current (I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ON</sub>), I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ON</sub>-to-I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OFF</sub> ratio, average subthreshold-swing (AVSS), gate-to-gate capacitance (C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">gg</sub>), trans-conductance (g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub>) and cut-off frequency (F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</sub>).

Author Keywords: Dual material gate electrode and Average subthreshold swing

articleTitle: Reliability evaluation of MPPT based interleaved boost converter for PV system
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The demand for power supply and depletion of the conventional energy sources are increasing drastically. So to overcome this problem, the best alternative power generation for conventional fossil fuel is Photovoltaic solar cell based system because of its advantage of pollution free and its availability in abundance with free of cost. In the MPPT based PV system the converters are the most sensitive part. Therefore to provide uninterrupted power supply without compromising the quality of power, reliability evaluation of interleaved boost converter becomes necessary. MATLAB/Simulink is used for the simulation studies and to determine the power losses of various components of the converter which is used in calculating the failure rates and reliability of the interleaved boost converter. Reliability studies of IBC have not been studied much. However there exists few literature in which reliability expression has been developed using Markov technique which is a more complex method as compare to Reliability Block Diagram (RBD). Therefore this paper proposes reliability modeling and reliability evaluation of Interleaved boost converter in MPPT based photo-voltaic system by using simple RBD method.

articleTitle: Pulse Width Modulation based Solar Charge Controller
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Solar Home Systems has the potential to offer many benefits to the user and to the society as a whole. The ease of using this clean energy makes it a viable choice. Solar Charge Controller (SCC) is a part of Solar Home System which is responsible for the energy conversion. The main aim of this work is to develop a high efficiency SCC at an affordable price without compromising on its performance. The proposed SCC works on the principle of Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) controlled DC-DC converter for charging the battery. PIC microcontroller is used in implementing the design. PWM pulses control the charging of the battery which are generated by the PIC microcontroller depending on various input variables. The designed SCC is tested to check whether it matches all the proposed technical specifications. The product is designed to support 120W of DC load.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms for the Classification of Power System Faults
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The transmission and distribution sectors of the power system are operated near the stability margin for the best usage of the existing infrastructure. The operation near the stability margin makes the power system susceptible to cascading failures, triggered by power system faults. As a result, the power quality and the reliability of the service provided by the utilities are identified to be at risk. Providing an adequate system that identifies the power system faults is highly essential for the faster restoration of the power supply. In this paper, a comparative analysis of the performance of three machine learning algorithms that classify the power system faults is studied. The voltage and current signals were extracted from a standard IEEE 14 bus system and different faulty and non-faulty cases were simulated in MATLAB Simulink. The multi-class dataset is used to train and test the models and the performance metrics such as accuracy, precision, and recall are used for the analysis. The main objective of this work is to report the performance of the classifiers and identify the best performing classifier.

articleTitle: Performance Improvement of Inverted Pendulum using Optimization Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The LQR control of inverted pendulum has been reported to be very effective in nature. Since the weighting matrices of LQR are arbitrary and can be chosen to improve the performance of inverted pendulum. This paper presents the application of three optimization algorithms for obtaining the weighting matrix Q used in LQ control of inverted pendulum. These are Genetic Algorithm (GA), Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) and Ant Colony optimization (ACO) Algorithms. With the help of simulation exercise the comparative performance of inverted pendulum has been demonstrated using optimized values of weighting matrices. From the results the performance of pendulum has much improved when LQ control is obtained using ACO.

Author Keywords: Artificial Bee Colony and Ant Colony Optimization

articleTitle: A 3-6 GHz CMOS Low Noise Amplifier with 14.8 dB Gain and 3 dB Noise Figure for UWB Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: An ultra-wideband 3 to 6 GHz Common Gate (CG) Low Noise Amplifier (LNA) using 0.18 μm CMOS process technology is demonstrated in this paper. The LNA employs a two stage common gate in cascade with cascode topology. Instead of single inductor L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> only, the input matching network includes series L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>-R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> in series with a parallel L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> to improve network bandwidth. The inductor L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">M</sub> provides high S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</sub>. The gain loss at medium and high frequencies is balanced by the passive components L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub> and L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">C</sub>. A better performance of power gain and Noise Figure (NF) is achieved. The S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</sub> of 14.8 dB and NF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">min</sub> of 3 dB are obtained. The average values of S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> and S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">22</sub> are -12.66 dB and -16.93 dB respectively for 3 GHz to 6 GHz UWB frequency.

articleTitle: Performance Evolution of Reconfigurable Antenna Using Contact and Non Contact Feeding Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The major demand need of wireless communication are less weight, optimization in cost and antennas with Small height that are adequate of obtaining high efficient performance over a frequencies of wide range. Micro-strip patch antennas are widely used for the range of 2 to 4 GHz (S-band) frequencies. Antenna design and simulation was done using HFSS (High Frequency Structural Simulator). Generally these antennas uses different feeding techniques like Micro Strip Line, co-axial and proximity, aperture coupled feeds. The proposed reconfigurable rectangular microstrip patch antenna has been tested using Co-axial, Aperture coupled Feed Techniques to improve the antenna parameters like Frequency and VSWR, Return Loss.

articleTitle: Half Psi Shaped Dual Band CP Antenna for WLAN/Wi-Fi Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In the past few years, the accelerated developments in the contemporary wireless communication systems needs the invention of inexpensive, light weight, low-profile and compact CP antennas capable of operating at two or more different frequencies. In this paper, a half psi shaped dual band CP antenna for Wi-Fi and WLAN appliances is projected and analyzed. This antenna consists of half psi shaped radiating patch on low cost FR-4 with 1.6 mm thickness. It has a ε<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub> value of 4.4 and a loss tangent of 0.02. The designed CP patch antenna is resonated at the two different frequencies of 2.4 and 5.2 GHz with the S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> value below -10 dB. The designed CP antenna has the normalized gains of 3.1 dB and 4.2 dB at the corresponding resonant frequencies. The projected CP antenna is designed and analyzed with the help of the HFSS software.

articleTitle: Design of Fractional Hilbert Transform (π/4)
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The Hilbert transform plays a very significant role in theory of signal processing and digital communication. It is widely used in optical systems, modulation and edge detection. In this paper, the design of the generalized form of the Hilbert transform, the Fractional Hilbert transform is proposed. The coefficients of the FIR fractional Hilbert transform for different orders (5, 10,15) has been calculated using weighted least square error method. The optimization technique used is Genetic algorithm. At the end results for the different orders have been compared.

articleTitle: Toggle Count Based Logic Obfuscation
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: With the popularity of internet and technology evolving rapidly, providing security is becoming difficult. The available methodologies and techniques like Camouflaging, Split Manufacturing and Logic Obfuscation aim to reduce the effects caused by piracy and reverse engineering(RE). The existing design for trust is feasible to track the inputs by brute force attacks. An obfuscation module shall be proposed to enhance the security of integrated chips(IC). In this methodology, the nodes of insertion of Obfuscation cells are decided based on toggle count and controllability. In this technique, it is ensured that the corrupted output is obtained when the wrong key is given.

articleTitle: An energy efficient IoT based Healthcare System based on clustering technique
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Rapid development in the field of IoT and sensing technologies makes a way of IoT based health monitoring in an effective manner. Among the diverse solution to reduce the energy utilization of the IoT gadgets, in this paper, a clustering technique is introduced to effectively make use of the available energy. The intention of this technique is to groups of IoT devices into clusters and an advanced node, i.e. special node with high processing capability will be used as cluster head (CH) and the nearby IoT devices will join the cluster as cluster members. This proposed method can be employed to gather data patient related data as well as infrastructure details like patient's biological data such as heart rate and blood pressure, temperature, parking facility, pharmacy, etc. The effectiveness of the proposed model is investigated and compared to the traditional solution with no clustering process involved. For experimentation, two performance measures namely number of data transmission and total number of data transmission to the cloud platform are used. The simulation results verified that the inclusion of clustering technique reduces the energy consumption in a significant way.

articleTitle: Optimum Modelling of Damping Coefficient and its Settling Time for a Large Hydro Alternator: A Case Study on impact of Non-Electric Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Hydro alternators plays a vital role in generating low cost power since it involves no further investment on energy source and system replacement. In most of the developing countries, this low cost power generation plays vital role in balancing the energy markets in terms of its economic operation. But, owing to its large installation capacity, the alternators possess huge rating and size. As the rating and the size increases, the machine start and stop procedure pro-longs and hence the term stability is attained after a minimum period of start of generation. This is due to the high inertia constant and in detail due to the lack of synchronization which leads to excessive damping of the entire system. And hence optimal design of the damping coefficient ( K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub>) is desired in order to bring the system to stability. The K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub> directly depends on the respective damping coefficient design of Automatic Voltage Regulation (AVR) and the Power System Stabilizers (PSS). A small signal stability experienced by such systems may be due to two reasons a) Due to Electric Dynamics (ED) b) Due to Non-Electric Dynamics (NED). The former is a most common phenomenon and is most widely monitored. But the latter is often discarded in majority of the stability analysis. Earlier studies have pinpoint results on the impacts of NED on the stability of the system. And hence, a joint research analysis on optimal modeling of the damping coefficient and the impacts of NED have scope in the installed systems. The work presented here concentrates on two thing a) optimal model-ling of the K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub> and later optimally reducing its settling time using constrained optimization technique b) upon the designed value of K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub> the impact of NED is studied and inference is discussed. The entire work is carried out by taking a large hydro-alternator of 66.67MVA which is installed at a Hydro Electric Generating Station located in India. The alternator is optimally modeled using dynamic equations and then the settling time is further optimized. Later the developed model is taken out for analysis of NED. The work is carried out in MATLAB Simulink Platform.

articleTitle: Improved Speed Response of ECM Drive Using Antiwindup Concept
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Recently, the ECM (electronic communicated motor) is gaining popularity in automation area, and household applications due to its cheapness, accessible regulation techniques, the lesser part maintaining and large range torque. But due to nonlinearity behavior of ECM motor just like saturation, disturbance etc. speed response is disturbed from the desired output. In my paper, starting torque or starting current has to be reduced by using a saturation technique, but speed response is not according to desired outputs. So to sort out this problem we will use Antiwindup PID instead of conventional PID. In closed loop system speed deterioration happens due to saturation of the integral part of PID which is known as windup problem. Same windup problem cause increase in overshoot and settling time of speed and torque characteristics. The ECM drive system along with Antiwindup PID and current controller has been developed in the MATLAB, Simulink Dynamic behavior of the system has been systematically studied and to prove system effectiveness and validity. Comparative study has been done to understand the differences in response.

articleTitle: Wavelet Based Digital Image Watermarking Algorithm Using Fractal Images
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: With increasing development of information technology, electronic publishing is becoming more popular, so need for copyright protection has been increased. Digital watermarking is used to protect digital data from being altered. This paper presents an algorithm to embed fractal images in wavelet domain using LWT (Lifting Wavelet Transform). Fractal image is generated from Quadtree decomposition and converted into binary image. This binary image is used as watermark. Cover image is converted into RGB components and binary watermark is inserted into mid frequency bands of cover image to protect information from attackers. Watermark is implanted in the blue component of RGB image. The PSNR, SSIM, and NC values obtained in this research show that the method is imperceptible and robust against signal distortions such as contrast enhancement, gamma correction, image sharpening, Gaussian filter, etc.

articleTitle: Robust Hybrid Watermarking using Image and Audio against Synchronization Attacks
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Hybrid Watermarking Approach is one of the trending approaches in the field of information security. Watermarking has a variety of applications to ensure data authentication, security, verification and copyrights protection of digital media. The proposed approach is hybrid watermarking applied on image and audio. We proposed a scheme in which the image is blindly embedded over original data with the help of Discrete Wavelength Transformation(DWT) and Singular value decomposition(SVD). Now the watermarked image is embedded into an audio signal by taking advantage of the histogram by making a gathering of three neighboring bins having various samples into it and later histogram is pulled out from embedding range by quoting to the modified mean. There is appropriate security analysis of the hybrid watermarking with respect to robustness and imperceptibility mainly against synchronization attacks and we also analyze the robustness in the case of common attacks.

articleTitle: Latest Trends in Security, Privacy and Trust in IOT
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: IoT is considered as very smart and intelligent devices and their sensors which results in many new challenges towards their security and privacy. Affirmation of data and assurance of things is one of the key challenges in the IoT. This paper gives a survey, examination and logically arrangement of security and assurance challenges in IoT.

articleTitle: Differential Evolution based Voltage Injection Scheme for Maintaining Constant Load Voltage
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Injection voltage is planned using a series voltage injection scheme to keep the desired load voltage at load end with considering load power factor as variable with source voltage as fixed and variable. This injected voltage is optimized as control variable so as to get the required voltage at load end. For this differential evolution has been used to validate the injected voltage and the obtained results are also simulated in MATLAB. For the presented work short transmission line model has been considered and In order to maintain load voltage constant, planning is done for injection voltage by considering different values of source voltage, power factor angle, active and reactive power. Planning is done for injection voltage is a kind of Dynamic Voltage restorer (DVR) used for injecting controllable voltage to keep the desired voltage, Thus injected voltage is estimated by Differential Evolution (DE) and validated by MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: SQAC Using Folding-Merging Based Squarer
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In DSP applications, there is a need for accumulation of the squares. In this paper,architecture for 16-bit squarer-accumulator(SQAC) is proposed and designed using folding and merging based 8-bit squarer. The carry-look-ahead adder (CLA) is used to add the squarer output to that of an accumulator. The functionality of the proposed 16-bit SQAC is analyzed using Xilinx Vivado and performance is compared with the two individual 16-bit SQAC is implemented using Radix-4 &Radix-8 based Booth multiplier at 45nm technology using Cadence Encounter RTL Compiler. The experimental results convey that area, power & delay has been diminished for the proposed SQAC by 46.55%, 48.35% & 59.82% and by 48.76%,45.34% & 51.76% as compared with SQAC using Radix-4 based Booth multiplier and SQAC using Radix-8 based Booth multiplier respectively.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Channel Coding Techniques for Cooperative Adhoc Network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: -In wireless networks, Cooperative communication can be used to increase the strength of the communication by means of spatial diversity. Basic idea that exists behind Cooperative communication is, if the transmission from source to destination is not successful, a helping node called relay can be used to send the same information to the destination through independent paths. In order to improve the performance of such communication, channel coding techniques can be used which reduces the Bit Error Rate. Previous works on cooperative communication only concentrated on improving channel capacity through cooperation. Hence this paper presents different Channel coding methods such as Turbo coding, Convolutional coding, and low-density parity-check coding over Rayleigh fading channels in the presence of Additive white Gaussian noise. Performance of these Channel coding techniques are measured in terms of noise power spectral density (N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">O</sub> ) vs. Bit error rate.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Sense Amplifier Flip-Flop with Completion Detection Signal
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Sense amplifier is a part of read circuitry used to read data from memory. It amplifies the low voltage signals to high logic level signal. It has wide range of applications such as in memory storage, level shifter and bus driver. This paper explains the design of Sense Amplifier based flip flop (SAFF) with control signal as Transition Completion Detection (TCD). The flip flop (FF) is designed in gpdk180nm technology and simulated using Cadence tool. Performance analysis of Conventional SAFF, Power PC master slave flip flop and SAFF with control signal TCD are compared in terms of delay, power and power delay product. Power for different value of voltage is compared for designed FF. Simulation results show that, 6% reduction of power for Sense amplifier FF with control signal TCD compared to Power PC Master slave FF at 1 volt supply voltage. Compared to Conventional SAFF, designed SAFF with control signal TCD reduces clock to Q delay about 4.7%. To analyze the working operation of SAFF with control signal TCD, a new circuit proposed and is designed using 2:1 multiplexer. Simulation result shows that, power and clock to Q delay of designed circuit are in the order of 26.87 μwatt and 30.23 nsec respectively.

articleTitle: Efficient Multi-Bit Error Tolerant design for MVM
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Matrix based computations are a typical way to implement many day-to-day systems. In particular, matrix vector multiplication has been implemented to provide solutions to wide range of contemporary issues. The work proposed in this paper is to detect and locate errors present in the results of a matrix vector multiplication. In matrix vector multiplication, computations are run in parallel. Categorically, this work aims to provide a mechanism to use checksum, linear binary coding technique to identify underlying faults in computational results. The necessary mathematical formulations have been derived and the design is synthesised to estimate the impact of efficient multi bit error tolerance for matrix vector multiplication. It is noticed that multi bit error tolerance for matrix vector multiplication is achieved with power optimisation compared to single bit error tolerance.

articleTitle: Digital Twin Ranorex Test Automation of SIPROTEC 5 Protection Devices
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Digital Twin (DT) is the ability to take virtual representation of the elements and the dynamics of how an Internet of Things device operates and it's more than a blueprint which lives throughout its lifecycle. It is an understanding of dynamics. Digital Twin facilitates the actual operation of the product as well. DT focuses on smart manufacturing with optimized hardware. Bay level is one of the Levels among different Kinds of Energy Automation, this level comprises of Intelligent Electronic Devices (IED) to correct the fault occurred at process level. In this work Automation of DT web page having the scenarios such as logging onto web page, Importing the SIMFILE, Starting Manual Test, Injecting Voltage, Current and Binary as inputs finally logging off from web page are carried out using Ranorex Tool, this paper also explains some of the configuration steps like Information Routing Matrix and Creating Continuous Function Chart (CFC) for interlocking conditions of Disconnector (DC), Circuit Breaker (CB ) of SIPROTEC devices using DIGSI tool.

articleTitle: Elimination of Leakage Current in Grid-Tied PV Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: New topology for transformerless inverter, connected to grid with PV system as a source is introduced in this paper. It incorporates charge pump circuit included inverter. This concept is used specially, to supply high side power circuitry. It produces negative output voltage at the output terminals of the inverter. Therefore when the neutral of grid and negative terminal of inverter are connected, the problem of leakage current and common mode voltage is totally ejected. This whole circuitry includes two schottky diodes, two capacitors and four MOSFETs with LCL filter. The switching pattern necessary to trigger the power switches is generated with modified SPWM technique. The control strategy using modified single phase p-q theory is introduced to control the injected current into grid by regulating the power. Finally this gives sinusoidal output current. A simulink model of this proposed work is given, which consists of open loop and closed loop models. The simulation results verify the performance as per requirements of topology.

articleTitle: A Novel approach for Denoising palm leaf manuscripts using Image Gradient approximations
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This paper developed a novel algorithm to denoise old palm leaf manuscript using local Otsu thresholding and Sobel operator-based image gradient approximations. Initially an intense literature review is conducted on the existing document noise removal algorithms and implemented some of the algorithms which promised to give good PSNR values. Based on the results obtained, background noise removal algorithm using local features, gave the best results for denoising palm leaf manuscripts in terms of Peak signal to noise ratio and Mean Square Error. The values obtained are 14.64 db, 0.002 and 0.03 respectively. But the performance of this algorithm heavily depends on the threshold value used for filtering the document and is having a high computational complexity and overhead. So novel denoising algorithm is developed which can solve the drawbacks of the existing, document noise removal using local features algorithm. Using this enhanced algorithm, the PSNR, SSIM and MSE values obtained are 14.69, 0.003 and 0.02 respectively. So based on these parameter values, this novel approach proves best for palm leaves manuscript as compared to the various other algorithms existing for this purpose.

articleTitle: Design of 9-Switch Converter for DFIG System for Active and Reactive Power Control by PID and Fuzzy Logic Controller
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Double Fed Induction Generator (DFIG) is widely used in wind power plants as energy conversion is easy and stabilized output can be achieved. The 6-pulse converters are used to control the reactive and active power it requires rectifier and inverter with dc link with capacitor for stabilization of dc voltage at rotor and grid side. But in these converters the output power is pulsating and the cost of such system will be more. To minimize such problems, 9-switch converter design is proposed in this paper it require 9-switches in rectifier and inverter side but in 6-pulse requires 12 switches. Thus 9-switch converter is cost effective and simple to operate. In controlling section of Double Fed Induction Generator (DFIG) system based converter model, the conventional PID controllers are used, in which the system is oscillatory at output which effects system and requires more controlling parameters to stabilize system, but with fuzzy logic control the system oscillations are reduced with minimum controlling parameters.

Author Keywords: Fuzzy Logic Controller and Proportional Integral Differential Controller

articleTitle: SATA Protocol implementation on FPGA for Write Protection of Hard Disk Drive/Solid State Device
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Write protection of storage media is essential in cyber forensics which ensures data integrity in storage devices. In order to write protect the storage devices such as Hard Disk Drive (HDD) or Solid State Device (SSD), hardware based solution is secure and better than the software based solution. Software based approach implements under an operating system that is susceptible to viruses and other attacks. An operating system, by definition, provides open access to applications and thus exposes these access points to improper use. Software can be corrupted or negated, while hardware cannot and hence Hardware based approach ensures root of trust. In fact, dedicated hardware can always out-perform software running on a general purpose OS-based platform with respect to performance and security benchmarking. In this paper, Xilinx's Kintex-7 FPGA based hardware with 2 SATA interfaces is used to implement SATA protocol with write protection for Hard Disk Drive (HDD) or Solid State Device (SSD). SATA Bridge IP core with write protection module is implemented on Kintex-7 FPGA which enables only data read operations and disables write operations of HDD/SSD.

articleTitle: Enhanced Long Range IRIS Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Iris refers to the highly textured, externally visible annular tissue present in the eye. This uniqueness of each iris' textured pattern can be used to uniquely identify human beings. Numerous applications have found their way to recognise human beings using iris recognition system, for example Aadhaar, passport, Access Control, border control, etc. Traditional Iris Recognition Systems used near-Infrared sensors to retrieve the textural detail of the varied iris patterns, ignoring the eye colour, but it had a trade-off of limiting the image acquisition distance to under a metre. Iris systems are structure and realization that work at longer deadlock divisions stretching out from 1 m to 60 m has been different undertakings. The structures can give high customer convenience and improved throughput which go for iris verifying and affirmation. An iris-affirmation at-an expel (IAAD) systems can be inspected for the bleeding edge plan and utilization. The physical obligation of this paper contains: Examining the centrality and utilizations of IAAD frameworks with regards to human acknowledgment. Giving a audit of existing IAAD frameworks. Exhibiting a total answer for the structure issue of distance framework for equipment and algorithmic points of view. Talking about the utilization of extra visual data, alongside iris, for improving distance precision. Talking about the flow look into difficulties and giving proposals to upcoming enquiry in IAAD.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Reconfigurable Digital Modulator using Vivado System Generator
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In general, there exist various communication subsystems. Since digital modulation occurs in simple, security in large distance transmission, the noise detection and correction is more efficient. To acquire optimal SNR different modulation techniques have been used, based on their requirements. They are amplitude, phase and frequency. These techniques can be are used on FPGA. PSK modulation techniques using different bits are mainly used for communication. The design f reconfigurability using Vivado system generator 2015.3v have been projected in this paper, where modulations occurs randomly and it is reconfigured built on the necessity during any precise occurrence. Modulators used in this work includes BASK, BFSK, BPSK and QAM. The output is observed using scope of the system generator.

Author Keywords: Reconfigurable system and Vivado System Generator

articleTitle: Design and Development of Software Tool for Code Clone Search, Detection, and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Replicating a piece of code with or without making minor changes in their code during project development is a normal practice adopted by the developers to reduce their production time which results in code/program clones. Clones could also occur in their existing file without any prior knowledge of the programmer. Though code/program cloning helps to increase the productivity initially, later it may increase the maintenance cost. Hence code/program cloning needs to be identified thoroughly during the development in a frequent interval of time. The main objective of this work involves in depth analysis of source code produced by the programmer for code cloning and to indicate how much percentage of code is copied in that their file. The proposed work detects clones in terms of syntax, function, method, variables, data types, keywords, spaces, author name, imports, commented lines, number of lines, and last-modified-date and shows the similarity percentage in graphically.

articleTitle: Image Processing Based on Emotive and Perfomance Mangement System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The institutions on a whole have been installed with cameras and in future every institution will be monitored by the camera and it will be used as bate to solve the problems related to the productivity of an individual during their study hours or working hours either it can be a school, company or a college. We address the impacts of emotion on intellectual processes, propose a basic theory for recognizing emotions, and survey a few existing techniques applied in affective computing, and motivate the reason for controlled integration of these techniques in AI. We act therefore we feel. Neurological Theory: Emotion is a mental state due to influence of certain neuro chemicals (think hormones) behavior, long-term memory. This paper primarily deals with the emotion and performance analysis on various students ranging from school to graduate level.

articleTitle: Pre-processing of SAR Images through Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Any remote sensing image regardless of the source (satellite, aircraft or any sensors and platforms) from which it is acquired undergoes distortion. This generally happens because of the various aspects concerning the optics, scanning mechanism; or motion, velocity, altitude and attitude associated with platforms or may be due rotations and curvature of the earth. Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imaging is one of the emerging technology of remote sensing which has grabbed the attention of most of the researchers. Also, in recent years Compressed Sensing (CS) theory has emerged in both signal processing and image processing domains. Compressed sensing promises image reconstruction at a lower sampling rate than traditional Nyquist sampling and hence CS can also be used for image retrieval. Not only this but CS also provides a faster and efficient way to reproduce the signals. This paper demonstrates the application of CS theory for pre-processing on high-resolution images for SAR image reconstruction.

articleTitle: Motion based Object Detection based on Background Subtraction: A Review
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In real-life conditions, the detection of the moving thing is a largely developing research area for this current technology-oriented generation. This research area is a good and interesting choice for the video surveillance system and has drawn the attention of various academicians and researchers who introduce advancements on the current technology. This paper includes the basic study of the moving object detection using background subtraction in the video surveillance system and different representations of the object that has been detected. The current existing problems related to the object detection are also discussed in this paper. The video surveillance system is a widely used security monitoring system used in places like hospital, ATMs, holy places, and many different places where security is necessary. The basic building block of any surveillance system is the detection of the moving objects and analyzing them.

articleTitle: Minimization of Black hole Attacks in AdHoc Networks using Risk Aware Response Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Mobile Ad hoc Network (MANET) is the collection of mobile devices which could change the locations and configure themselves without a centralized base point. Mobile Ad hoc Networks are vulnerable to attacks due to its dynamic infrastructure. The routing attacks are one among the possible attacks that causes damage to MANET. This paper gives a new method of risk aware response technique which is combined version the Dijkstra’s shortest path algorithm and Destination Sequenced Distance Vector (DSDV) algorithm. This can reduce black hole attacks. Dijkstra’s algorithm finds the shortest path from the single source to the destination when the edges have positive weights. The DSDV is an improved version of the conventional technique by adding the sequence number and next hop address in each routing table.

articleTitle: Eye Controlled Wheelchair with Asthenopia Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In this paper we present a low cost and real time system which enables a person with quadriplegia to control his wheelchair with eye movements. This system is enabled by voice control. Once enabled, it processes consecutive frames from the web cam to detect the direction of eye movement. Consequently, a signal is sent to the Raspberry pi micro-controller, to turn the motors in the desired direction. Detection is done by pupil monitoring using contours. Additionally, it detects Asthenopia, a disease caused by straining of the eye. This is achieved by monitoring the blink rate of the patient. Blink Detection is carried out using two methods. The first method uses a combination of SURF and Harris corner detection while second method uses facial landmarks.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis for Optimising On State Current in a Dual Gate TFET
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Tunnel Field Effect Transistors (TFETs) are in future expected to replace MOSFETs, owing to its better characteristics that includes lower Subthreshold swing (SS), immunity towards short channel effects, and low leakage currents etc. At the same time TFET itself faces certain challenges in relation to its performance, the major among these include the low on current of the TFETs because of the poor tunneling efficiency. This paper gives a comprehensive analysis of various techniques utilized to enhance the on-state drive current in a doped dual gate TFET (DG-TFET). Various techniques are investigated and compared using TCAD SILVACO tool in order to get the optimum performance in terms of On-state drive current and at the same time the control over ambipolar current is also established. In order to optimize the performance DC and AC parameters are also analyzed and compared.

articleTitle: Reliability Modeling and Criticality Ranking of Power Substation
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Present day power system is quite complex and both industrial and domestic consumers demand 24×7 power supply. Therefore it has to be ultra reliable and safe in operation. An unscheduled outage and loss of generation occurs by the component failures of the power system. All the components in a system possess different failure rates/reliabilities due to their position in the system and their reliabilities affect system reliability differently. Therefore their criticality must be ascertained. In this paper, a power substation is modeled by the reliability block diagram (RBD) and hence the reliability of the system is calculated from the given data. Then the components of the RBD are ranked critically by Fussell Vesely importance measure. The most critical and the least critical components are found. Hence based on the criticality ranking of all the components, the reliability of the system can be improved.

articleTitle: LeCAM: A novel metric for detecting DDoS attacks
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Presently in the technological era, Internet is the sole medium to access and run web based services such as a business, banking, education, e-commerce, weather forecasting, etc. Because of the increasing usage of such services and dependency on the Internet, many types of malware threats have emerged over the time that affects the timely delivery of these services. Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attack is one of such crucial threats. Many researchers have proposed diversified DDoS detection approaches using information theory based entropy and divergence detection metrics in the past. This paper proposes to use a novel LeCam divergence metric to detect different types of DDoS attacks based on flow similarity between the network traffic flows. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is corroborated using widely used benchmarked MIT Lincoln and CAIDA datasets along with DDoSTB dataset. The results show that the novel LeCam Divergence metric is more effective as compared to the traditional Kullbeck-Leibler, Bhattacharyya and Pearson Divergence measures.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Parallel Boost Micro-Inverter for Solar PV Grid Integration
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Energy demand has been increasing rapidly across the globe. Present sources of energy are exhaustible, and supply is becoming limited. Therefore, there is an urgent need to conserve available resources and make as much use of energy as possible. Performance analysis of a Parallel Boost Micro Inverter for Solar PV Grid Integration is presented in this paper. Here, an improved DC to DC converter method has been implemented. This enhanced principle generates two isolated DC sources that can be inverted separately and connected in series with a high voltage step ratio or in parallel for applications with voltage source converters. The system simulation is built with the help of MATLAB / SIMULINK. State Space Modeling is performed to check the stability of the designed Parallel Boost Converter system. Inverting using SPWM technique is performed with unipolar and bipolar switching topologies for performing Harmonic content comparison. The SPWM method improves the efficiency and reduces the total harmonics distortion in the output voltage. The work can be used with Photovoltaic cell as grid integrated micro inverter, where no battery is associated. PV micro inverter not only focuses on the efficiency and cost but also on reliability.

articleTitle: Higher-Order Sliding-Mode Observer Based Robust Controller Design for Four-Tank Coupled System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This paper presents the design of a robust observer based controller for four-tank coupled system (FTCS) using higher-order sliding-mode control scheme. The FTCS is considered as a multiple-input and multiple-output (MIMO) nonlinear system having significant coupled dynamics. The problem of liquid level control for FTCS is considered to achieve the desired set point. First, a sliding mode observer of higher order has been designed so that the estimated states achieve convergence to the plant states. Based on this observer, a robust controller using super-twisting algorithm has been proposed which can improve the performance of the FTCS. The applicability of this proposed robust controller for FTCS has been illustrated through simulation studies. Finally, a comparison has been made with the existing controller for FTCS to show the efficacy of proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Comparision of an Off-Grid Solar Power Plant based Renewable Energy Production
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Renewable energy production has been of prime importance in the last few decades. Solar energy is something which is available almost everywhere and can be harnessed for use at every level from Domestic to Large scale Industrial supply. As an outcome of advancement in the solar cell efficiencies, governments and other agencies have been promoting use of solar energy from the past many years. For the purpose, benefits in the form of subsidies and other tax rebates have been offered to consumers. In this paper a detailed analysis is done to calculate yearly benefit to a Punjab (State in India) based domestic consumer after installation of an Off-Grid Solar power plant at his premises keeping in view Punjab government policies and unit energy rates. In addition to monetary benefits and energy units produced, other things like space constraint, freedom from faults and outages, environmental benefits have been discussed. Analysis based on yearly data, one year prior to installation and one year after installation of solar power plant has been given.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Vessel Parameters for the Detection of Hypertensive Retinopathy
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Medical literature have shown that measuring the changes in the artery to vein ratio and vessel tortuosity can help in the detection of Hypertensive Retinopathy. This paper presents a study of the fundus images of eyes of the patients for the detection of the same. With the evolution of computer technology, softwares can be designed to automatically detect the above abnormalities in the images, and therefore distress the burden of image examination by retinal experts. Image preprocessing and steps for the calculation of artery to vein ratio and vessel tortuosity will be discussed. For the implementation of project, fundus images of people suffering from hypertensive retinopathy (HR) and healthy patients have been collected from VICAVR, DRIVE database and a local eye clinic run by Dr. Althea Barbosa, Mapusa, Goa.

articleTitle: Sine cosine algorithm based staircase modulation for cascaded H-bridge inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method to solve the optimization (SCA) by using a sine cosine algorithm to remove the selected harmonics in a cascaded H-bridge (CHB) multi-level inverter. This method is used in high-voltage and high-power applications to easily reduce device switching loss and stress. Objective of this work to find optimal angles which suppresses the lower order harmonics and fundamental value of output voltage is constant regardless of change in input voltage.This proposed method SCA searches an optimal angle for a 7-Level inverter. This method will provide a better solution compression with PSO (Particle Swarm Optimization). So to present the effectiveness of SCA both the results have been compared with each other. Simulation results present that the SCA is the most accurate and lesser iteration technique for optimization of switching angles in staircase modulation.

articleTitle: Contour detection based on gaussian filter
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
